description:
Information Model.
  Based on the relational model and described in the book Information Modelling.

externalDocs.title: Information modelling - A method for improving understanding and accuracy in your collaboration
externalDocs.description: Original book written by Stefan Berner, describing the information model

allOf.description: Attributes specific for an information model

mainlanguage.description: Main (and possibly only) language of the models textelements. Serves as default language in multilingual strings, whenever for any of the languages a translation is missing.

languages.description: List of languages, model textelements can be translated to. Excluding mainLanguage. The mainlanguage must be present in every multilingual string.

Entities.description: List of entities making up this model

Attributes.description: List of attributes of entities and groupdomains. The names of all attributes within one entity (or within one domain) must be unique

Domains.description: List of domain used in this model

Relations.description: List of relations in this model

Categories.description: List of categories, used to group elements in this model.

additionalProps.description: additional properties (aka user defined properties udp) are  any properties of an this element  added by the current modeller. They serve as an extension to the predfefined element properties.
